sentences.text: Brian Michael Lynch -LRB- born June 21 , 1973 -RRB- is an American film and comic book writer .

Lynch was the initial writer and co-creator with Joss Whedon of Angel : After the Fall for IDW Publishing , and is best known for writing the screenplays for the films Puss in Boots and Minions .	Joss Whedon	Joss Whedon	IDW Publishing	IDW Publishing	Puss in Boots	Puss in Boots (2011 film)	Minions	Minions (film)
He has also written an unproduced film adaptation of The Sims .	The Sims	The Sims
